   - The conditional check that previously determined whether to call `loadUserTypes` recursively based on the size of `notLoaded` has been removed. Instead, `loadUserTypes(notLoaded, ks)` is now called unconditionally at the end of the method.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `BulkLoader.java` are directly related to fixing a bug that arose from a previous commit. The addition of the early return for empty user types ensures that the loader can handle keyspaces without user-defined types gracefully, preventing potential errors or unnecessary processing. The removal of the conditional check for `notLoaded` simplifies the logic, ensuring that the method always attempts to load any user types that were not loaded previously, even if that list is empty. This change enhances the robustness of the loader when dealing with keyspaces that do not contain user types.
